checks.result: Saved the actual P5-002 development session at base revision 193 and closed it interrupted at revision 196. Updated the real ledger progress while closed; sources refreshed to revision 198 and work entity revision 4 -> 5. Resume created a successor and new explicit claim at revision 199. Its complete L1 used 4973 tokens and preserved the saved next action/open loop, all five current hard rules verbatim, and source changes. Recompiling the same request was identical; source bytes were unchanged by resume. The successor then saved its own checkpoint and ended at revision 202; doctor passed.

checks.name: bounded_independent_code_review
checks.result: A separate read-only reviewer checked source/revision gates, session/claim atomicity, checkpoint inheritance and target-agent hard rules. It confirmed the checkpointless recovery-baseline defect; the root agent reproduced and fixed it, then the reviewer confirmed the independent baseline, continuous successors and context-retry paths preserve the source-change window. This was static feature review, not E4 business acceptance.

limitations: Feature-local validation and real project self-use only; no E4 scenario, system benchmark or release claim. The actual self-use stayed on its real agent/provider/model; changing those metadata and agent-scoped hard rules was exercised in isolated fixtures, not external provider execution. Resume records environment identity and compiles context; it does not invoke a model. Missing historical checkpoint memory remains explicitly unavailable; incomplete saves are excluded rather than repaired. Reconciliation, broad validation and release work remain scheduled.
